page_title: JUV 1-1 INT | Juventus v Inter 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+1' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

90+1' Alex Sandro (Juventus) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Inter earn a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' The substitution has been made. Alex Sandro (Juventus) has replaced Filip Kostic.
88' Substitution. Marcus Thuram is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
88' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Nicolo Barella is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
87' Juan Cuadrado (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Wojciech Szczesny comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Matteo Darmian (Inter) is penalised for holding. Marco Guida signals a set piece.
83' Substitution. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hakan Calhanoglu walks off.
81' Good movement by Carlos Augusto (Inter), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
80' Here is a change. Dusan Vlahovic is going off and Massimiliano Allegri gives the last tactical orders to Moise Kean (Juventus).
80' Here comes a substitution. Federico Chiesa is given a rest as he is replaced by Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus).
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Filip Kostic (Juventus) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Juan Cuadrado (Inter) for his blatant foul.
74' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Guida blows his whistle for an infringement.
73' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.
71' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marco Guida who sees an offensive foul.
71' Nicolo Barella (Inter) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
70' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Juan Cuadrado (Inter) replaces Denzel Dumfries.
70' Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
69' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Marco Guida blows his whistle and it's Federico Gatti (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
65' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Federico Chiesa (Juventus).
63' Nicolo Barella (Inter) probably handled the ball.
63' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
61' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Locatelli (Juventus).
58' Inter players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
54' Marco Guida blows for a foul after Federico Dimarco (Inter) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
50' Marcus Thuram (Inter) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the left side of the goal. Wojciech Szczesny is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
47' Marcus Thuram (Inter) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Guida starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Federico Gatti (Juventus) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Federico Dimarco passes to Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes well wide of the right post.
40' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' A spell of possession for Juventus in an attempt to control the game.
33' 1 - 1 What a hit! Lautaro Martinez (Inter) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
31' Nicolo Barella (Inter) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
30' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

27' 1 - 0 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Federico Chiesa assisted in the goal. 1:0.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:4. The shots on goal statistics – 0:2.
23' A huge rebound finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter) unmarked on the edge of the box. He lines up a shot but slips just before he hits it and sends the ball miles wide of the left post.
20' What an opportunity! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
18' A brilliant cross into the box finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
17' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
16' Adrien Rabiot rounds off a good move with a layoff to Federico Chiesa (Juventus) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
14' The corner from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Juventus) is intercepted by Yann Sommer.
13' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Filip Kostic (Juventus), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
11' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
10' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
8' Some great controlled play and passing from Inter. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

4' Marcus Thuram (Inter) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the target, but Wojciech Szczesny keeps the ball out.
3' Poor challenge! Daniele Rugani (Juventus) is penalised for tripping and Marco Guida blows his whistle. Inter win a free kick.
1' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) cracks a shot goalwards from the edge of the box, but his radar is off and it sails well wide of the left post.
1' The first half has just begun.
Juventus will kick-off.
Marco Guida will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
